title: Best Georgia Holidays - 7 days
highlights: Discover Tbilisi’s vibrant Old Town with a guided evening city tour.
Visit Mtskheta and enjoy a sweet and wine-tasting session.
Explore Martvili and Okatse Canyons and Prometheus Cave in Kutaisi.
Walk across Dashbashi Canyon’s iconic Diamond Bridge.
Enjoy Kazbegi and Gudauri, including Gergeti Trinity Church and Friendship Arch.
Spend a relaxing free day in Kazbegi or Gudauri.
overview: Green Sky Travel invites you to experience the best of Georgia in a seven-day adventure. From historic Tbilisi and Mtskheta to Kutaisi’s breathtaking canyons and the serene mountains of Kazbegi and Gudauri, this tour is a gateway to Georgia’s culture, nature and history. Explore vibrant streets, taste wine in Mtskheta, discover magical canyons, cross Dashbashi Canyon’s Diamond Bridge and enjoy spectacular mountain views.

sections.title: Seven Days of History, Culture and Natural Beauty
paragraphs: Arrive in Tbilisi, explore Mtskheta and enjoy wine tasting, then discover Kutaisi’s canyons and caves, Dashbashi Canyon, Kazbegi and Gudauri.
Relax in the mountains before a private transfer from Kazbegi or Gudauri to Tbilisi or the airport.

itinerary.title: Transfer from Tbilisi Airport to Hotel
description: Our team will greet you near the information center with green scarves.
Enjoy a comfortable door-to-door transfer to your Tbilisi hotel.
Begin your Georgian adventure with a smooth arrival.

itinerary.title: Mtskheta Old Capital of Georgia – Sweet and Wine Tasting
itinerary.description: Explore Mtskheta, Georgia’s ancient capital and spiritual center. Enjoy sweet and wine tasting followed by a guided evening city tour of Tbilisi.

itinerary.title: Kutaisi Canyons and Caves from Tbilisi Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Take a full-day excursion to Kutaisi and discover Martvili Canyon, Okatse Canyon and Prometheus Cave.

itinerary.title: Diamond Bridge and Dashbashi Canyon
itinerary.description: Visit Dashbashi Canyon and cross the Diamond Bridge while enjoying spectacular Georgian landscapes.

itinerary.title: Kazbegi and Gudauri Full-Day Tour
itinerary.description: Travel through Kazbegi and Gudauri, visit Gergeti Trinity Church and see the Friendship Arch.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Kazbegi or Gudauri
itinerary.description: Relax, explore independently or unwind amid the mountain scenery of Kazbegi or Gudauri.

itinerary.title: Private Transfer from Gudauri or Kazbegi to Tbilisi or Tbilisi Airport
itinerary.description: Travel by private transfer to Tbilisi or directly to the airport, depending on your onward travel plans.

goodToKnow: Expert guides and drivers provide support throughout the journey.
Georgia’s climate varies, so pack layers for mountain regions.
The official currency is Georgian Lari (GEL); carry cash for remote areas.
A local SIM card is recommended for rural areas.
Comfortable shoes are essential for canyon visits.
